value.name: Asha silences Daniel's advance
value.description: Asha's hand striking the metal stops Daniel where he stands and establishes her control of the exchange.
evidence: flat sound of her hand meeting the metal made him stop where he stood.
Asha let the silence hold a beat longer than was comfortable

value.name: Asha lets Lucia answer first
value.description: Asha deliberately holds the silence so Daniel hears that Lucia has already answered him before Asha speaks.
evidence: she wanted Daniel to hear that he had finally named a ground, and that Lucia had answered him before she did.

value.name: Daniel retreats and questions the seal
value.description: Daniel steps back from the lamp and asks who verified the notary's seal, trying to keep his tone calm and helpful.
evidence: Daniel took a slow step back from the lamp
The question came out in the same level, helpful tone he had tried before, but it had thinned at the edges.

value.name: Rosa refuses Daniel's framing
value.description: Rosa ignores Daniel's question, fixes him with a direct look, and answers by saying the door was locked.
evidence: Rosa did not answer that question; instead she looked straight at Daniel
The three short words landed before the notary one had finished settling

value.name: Rosa redirects the argument to the room
value.description: By refusing to answer the seal question, Rosa forces Daniel back to the physical facts of the room, the table, and the closed door.
evidence: Rosa was not going to follow him onto the ground he had chosen—that she was going to keep returning him to the room itself, the table, the closed door, the people who had been inside it.

value.name: Daniel loses his next question
value.description: Daniel fidgets with his cuff and abandons the follow-up question he had been preparing.
evidence: Daniel's hand went back to his cuff, working at nothing, and he did not ask the next question he had clearly been preparing.

value.name: Asha reclaims the codicil and key
value.description: Asha pulls the codicil and brass key toward herself, moving them out of the lamp-lit center and placing them by her elbow.
evidence: Asha drew the codicil and the brass key across the wood toward herself
a slow deliberate slide that took both out of the lamp-lit center of the table and set them at her own elbow

value.name: Asha confronts Daniel directly
value.description: Asha lifts her eyes and holds Daniel's gaze, asserting herself as the next speaker.
evidence: and then she lifted her eyes to Daniel and held them there.

value.name: Daniel hesitates under Asha's stare
value.description: Daniel initially does not move, his fingers still working at his cuff as Asha holds his gaze.
evidence: He did not move at first; only the small working of his fingers at his cuff stoppe
